dishes.name: Tartiflette
dishes.desc: Baked potatoes with bacon, onions and a generous layer of Reblochon. The best-known Savoyard dish, built on a cheese from the Thônes valley.

dishes.name: Reblochon
dishes.desc: Soft washed-rind cheese from the Thônes valley near Annecy, eaten on its own and used in many local recipes.

dishes.name: Fondue savoyarde
dishes.desc: A blend of melted Savoie cheeses eaten with bread, often alongside potatoes and charcuterie. Served in every Annecy restaurant.

dishes.name: Lake Annecy fish
dishes.desc: Féra and Arctic char from the lake, usually grilled or smoked. Lakeside restaurants in Annecy serve them as a signature plate.

dishes.name: Savoyard rissoles
dishes.desc: Fried pastry parcels filled with apple or pear, flavoured with cinnamon and dusted with icing sugar. A traditional Savoie sweet.
